title: Salamandra Technical Report
findings: Models exhibited a tendency to favor outputs aligned with societal biases when presented with ambiguous prompts involving religion, although the bias scores for the 'Religion' category were relatively low compared to other categories like age. In the Regard analysis for English, the Salamandra 2B model generated text with significantly more negative regard for minority groups and more positive regard for majority groups; however, no statistically significant differences were found for religion in other languages for the Salamandra models.
